metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear I was shooting the air and Valorant said ‘Yep, take it’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a kill by accident?
Enemy probably confused AF right now.
Click if your aim’s a total mess but the game still loves you.
Valorant logic is wild today.

Tap if your best kills happen by pure accident!
